subject: Inference fit: post-demo actions + quality probes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Craig Li <craig.li@novus.ai>, Katie Ramos <katie@novus.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Inference fit: post-demo actions + quality probes

Craig / Katie — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary from call:
- Novus is focused on 1) low 99th-pct latency for short-chat flows (~1–4 turns), 2) tight hallucination bounds on product spec answers, and 3) deployment in a hybrid model (hosted dev -> dedicated for prod).
- Your main comparators are the hyperscaler managed endpoints (CloudOne) and a smaller inference API you already tested (EdgeServe).

Proposed next tests (we can run these in our sandbox and give you results):
1) Token-level latency sweep (prompt lengths 16 / 64 / 256) — measure cold+warm 95/99th latency and per-token CPU/GPU utilization.
2) Hallucination probes: 150 targeted retrieval-style prompts (from the shared doc) with known-ground-truth checks + 50 adversarial prompts to stress entity binding.
3) Regression checks: 200 prompt pairs where we compare current model responses vs your production model for answer drift.
4) Cost/throughput demo: a 5k-request burst to show autoscaling behavior and fallback to quantized variants.

Deliverables we’ll share after tests: concise benchmark spreadsheet, representative traces (latency_samples.json), and the prompt suite (novus_test_prompts.csv).

Action items / owners: 
- Marissa: coordinate timeline and set milestone dates.
- Ben: run latency sweep and produce the spreadsheet.
- Rishi: run hallucination/regression probes and add quick evaluation script.
- Camila: validate deployment fit (network egress/KMS requirements) for dedicated later in the quarter.

Can you confirm the three priority slices above (latency, hallucination, deployment) and whether the proposed prompt suite covers the areas you care about? If yes, we’ll schedule the sandbox run early next week and share a drive link with live results.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Craig Li <craig.li@novus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Inference fit: post-demo actions + quality probes

Marissa — appreciated the clear recap. That matches our internal priorities. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- On hallucination probes: we need entity-level precision checks for our product catalog answers (SKU-level facts). Can you add a small sub-set (30 prompts) focused on SKU verification?
- For deployment fit, our security team requires answers about data retention, KV cache behavior, and whether any prefixes are stored outside customer VPCs. Camila — I’ll need a short checklist we can hand to our security reviewer.

If you can get the sandbox runs started Monday (US time), we’ll provide a sample of production prompts and a short dataset for the SKU checks. Also include a brief note about what fallback model you use when quantized variants are selected.

—Craig
Head of Integrations | Novus AI
craig.li@novus.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Craig Li <craig.li@novus.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: Inference fit: post-demo actions + quality probes

Team — forwarding Craig's clarifications. Please see quick plan below and callouts on timing. I want to get a sandbox report to Novus by EOD Tuesday (48 hours).

Ben — latency sweep plan:
- Run three sequence-length buckets: 16, 64, 256 tokens. Warm/cold distinction: run 200 warm requests after a 10-min idle and 200 cold (start-from-zero) samples for each bucket. Capture 50th/95th/99th latencies and GPU utilization per-sample. Output: redwood_vs_hyperscaler-metrics.xlsx + latency_samples.json.

Rishi — quality probes:
- SKU verification subset: add 30 SKU prompts that map to exact-match checks (Novus will provide dataset).
- Hallucination probe set: 150 prompts from their doc (we already have a seed in the drive link), plus 50 adversarial prompts we will design. Use our eval harness to compute precision/recall and hallucination rate per prompt type. Please include short failure examples in the report.

Camila — deployment/security checklist for Novus security team:
- Data retention policy (hosted vs dedicated), KMS integration options, KV cache behavior (no cross-tenant persistence), audit log availability, SOC2 evidence location. Can you produce a 1-page checklist?

Attachments I’ll include to Novus today: novus_test_prompts.csv (seed), redwood_vs_hyperscaler-metrics.xlsx (template), latency_samples.json (trace format).

If anything blocks the Monday sandbox run, flag it here ASAP.

Thanks —
Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 16:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Inference fit: post-demo actions + quality probes

All — thumbs up. I’ll own the latency sweep tomorrow morning PST. Quick notes: 
- I’ll run baseline against CloudOne (their managed endpoint) and our hosted + quantized dedicated variant so Novus sees the delta.
- Will attach the spreadsheet and sampled traces here when done. Expected artifacts: redwood_vs_hyperscaler-metrics.xlsx (filled), latency_samples.json (5–10 representative traces), and a short README with test commands.

Rishi — do you want me to ship the trace files to the eval harness bucket or drop them with you? I can share a presigned link to the traces if that speeds things up.

Camila — I’ll peer with you on the KMS question; I remember we have a short PPT on KMS/HSM integrations that should cover their security reviewer.

Ben
Product Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0122
